narrative.northStar: The Living Room, Day and Night
narrative.overview: Every colour is an ink sampled from the render of Mathieu's living room. By day: cream paper, walnut-black ink, oxblood. By night: the same room after dark, with brass, the lamp, in place of oxblood. The home page is a bento of fixed-height cards, each one real object from Mathieu's life; inner pages are calm reading pages of hairline rows and long text. Instrument Serif sets titles, Geist sets the interface and the reading, Geist Mono sets dates and counts. Motion is springy and comes from one file of presets.
keyCharacteristics: Primitive OKLCH ramps plus semantic roles; components name roles only.
Oxblood accent by day, brass by night.
Instrument Serif display, Geist UI, Geist Mono metadata.
One card grammar: one inset, one eyebrow row, media to the edge.
The hairline lives inside the shadow; cards have no border.

rules.name: The Roles Only Rule
rules.body: Components name roles, never a ramp step or a dark: colour variant. design-tokens.test.ts enforces it.

rules.name: The Lamp Rule
rules.body: Oxblood by day, brass by night. Never carry one into the other theme.

rules.name: The Night Scrim Rule
rules.body: The scrim is night in both themes; .dark does not re-role it.

rules.name: The Dither Rule
rules.body: Place photos are an ordered-dither duotone in --dither-ink and --dither-paper, so mixed sources read as one set.

rules.name: The One Serif Weight Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif is loaded at 400 only; serif hierarchy comes from size.

rules.name: The Serif for Names Rule
rules.body: The serif sets titles, the greeting and logo initials; UI and prose stay in Geist.

rules.name: The Hairline in the Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add a border to a card; the 1px ring is the first layer of every elevation.

rules.name: The Glass Rule
rules.body: Glass is card at 60%, 4px blur, 150% saturation; dialogs card at 80%, 8px blur.

rules.name: The Nested Radius Rule
rules.body: Media radius equals card radius minus the inset.

rules.name: The One Inset, One Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Every home card opens with the same 20px eyebrow row and holds content at the one inset.

rules.name: The Fixed Row Rule
rules.body: Bento rows have fixed heights; a card fits its cell.

dos: Do name roles in components, and add a role before reaching for a ramp.
Do give every home card the one inset and the one eyebrow row.
Do derive nested radii from rounded-card minus p-inset.
Do use the serif at 400 for titles, Geist for everything else, Geist Mono with tabular figures for dates and counts.
Do keep inner pages as hairline rows on the page background.
Do put the scrim behind any text set on a photograph.
Do show a 2px ring-role focus ring on every interactive element.
donts: Don't use a ramp step or a dark: colour variant in a component class.
Don't add a border to a card; the hairline lives in the shadow.
Don't wrap inner-page content in cards.
Don't set the serif bold, or set UI text in the serif.
Don't put an invented label above a page title. That slot holds real metadata only.
Don't let a bento card grow its row.
